field_checks.summary: Table 1 activity rows, MBIC rows, time-kill rows, in vivo bacterial-load rows, and toxicity rows are broadly represented, but the final activity layer omits the primary-source conflict where prose says BotrAMP14 inhibited/eliminated P. aeruginosa below 0.78 uM while Table 1 records 0.78 uM. The MIC/MBC row provenance also reuses xml:p:16 as a method locator, although xml:p:16 is a time-kill result; MIC and MBC methods are at xml:p:26 and xml:p:27.

All 42 fallback database rows are kept unresolved with zero source_verified rows, absent linked authoritative rows, and fallback ingest excluded. However, the final database artifact still carries unresolved_blockers, including final_artifact_requires_worker6_rebuild, while also claiming publication_grade/source_reviewed_complete and while the final review report reports zero live rework targets.

Paper final and packet final artifacts are byte-identical for the shared final files, and activity/toxicity/database/mechanism counts agree with review_report. The final materials_manifest mirror is nevertheless stale: it reports locator_count 132 and analysis_queue_status analysis_queued, while the live packet_manifest and locator_index report 170 locators and analysis_source_reviewed_accepted after supplementary repair.

The mechanism artifact contains three claims, with no direct_mechanism promotions. Prior SEM and membrane-disruption discussion are retained as inferred or phenotype-supported evidence rather than treated as direct mechanism evidence for this paper.

Paper identity is coherent for PMCID PMC12837634, DOI 10.3390/antibiotics15010077, title, and four peptide entities with reported masses. The current paper explicitly does not report complete amino acid sequences, so database identity remains non-authoritative and fallback-only.

All collected final locator strings resolve against XML/PDF/supplement locator surfaces, and approximate statuses are generally explicit. The provenance layer is still not publication-grade because MIC/MBC rows cite xml:p:16 as method evidence even though it is a time-kill result, and because the final materials_manifest locator count is stale relative to the live packet locator index.

Recursive authority is not asserted. DBAASP/APD/DRAMP-linked authoritative inputs are absent, fallback rows remain excluded from RC2/portal/authoritative ingest, and review_report open_rework_ticket_count equals the live packet ticket state of zero open tickets.

Known cautions for missing authoritative database linkage, BotrAMP14 hemolysis value differences, supplementary figure approximation, and strain-label discordance are present. A material source conflict is still missing for P. aeruginosa BotrAMP14: body prose states below 0.78 uM while Table 1 records 0.78 uM.

The staged supplementary ZIP, extracted supplementary PDF, OCR image, supplementary text, and S1 hemolysis evidence were inspected and are represented in locator surfaces. The source surface is exhausted, but the final materials_manifest is stale and does not reflect the live supplementary locator state.

Table hemolytic activity, cytotoxic IC50, the BotrAMP14 approximate hemolysis IC50, and S1 digitized hemolysis points are represented with exact or approximate status. Remaining toxicity concerns are cautions rather than blocking omissions.

The same activity layer also assigns xml:p:16 to MIC/MBC method locators even though xml:p:16 is a time-kill result, while MIC and MBC methods are described at xml:p:26 and xml:p:27.

cautions.summary: No linked authoritative DBAASP/APD/DRAMP/merged database rows are present; machine-extracted rows must remain fallback provenance only and excluded from authoritative ingest.

BotrAMP14 hemolysis has Table 1 activity concentration 128 uM, text IC50 approximately 92 uM, and S1 graph-derived approximate percent hemolysis points; these should remain explicitly qualified as approximate/conflicting rather than exact replacements.

The source uses A. baumannii 003321216 in Table 1 and figure captions but 00332121 in some body, time-kill, and in vivo prose; final curation should continue to preserve rather than normalize away this strain-label discordance.
Current mechanical and semantic gates are green, but independent source-level review found blocking field-level issues not caught by those gates.
